content: At every follow-up visit, healthcare providers should inquire about the patient’s smoking history. Patients who smoke should be actively discouraged from continuing this habit, and efforts should be made to encourage smoking cessation. The use of electronic cigarettes should also be discouraged, as they are not a safe alternative to traditional smoking. Pediatric diabetes care teams should begin preparing adolescents for the transition to adult healthcare systems, ideally starting this process during early adolescence. Healthcare providers should provide ongoing support and resources to adolescents, young adults, and their families throughout the transition from pediatric to adult care. Pediatric and adult diabetes care teams should work collaboratively with patients and their caregivers to ensure a seamless and effective transition between care systems.
